# GoFully

> The screenshot studio that stays on your device. A free Chrome extension to capture a full page, one element, a region or a scrolling panel; hide private details before you capture; measure spacing and colors; read text and QR codes on-device; mark up, beautify and export to PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF. No account, no uploads.

Status: v1.1.2 is live on the Chrome Web Store. v1.1.3 is the biggest release so far and publishes next: Draw on Page, Capture Element, Auto-redact, Redact page, Measure, delayed capture, the capture stack, QR code reading, Beautify, step-by-step guides and history search. It adds no new permissions. See the roadmap for details.

## Core Features & Capabilities

- [Full Page Screenshot Tool](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/): Capture full-height scrolling websites, dynamic feeds, and dashboards with automatic video auto-pause, cookie modal auto-dismiss, and sticky-header deduplication.
- [Draw on a Live Website](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-draw-on-a-live-website): Use GoFully's Draw on Page to sketch arrows, highlight text and add sticky notes right on a live website, then capture the visible area or the full page with your marks in place.
- [Capture a Single Element](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-capture-a-single-element): Capture just one card, table, chart or chat message in Chrome. GoFully's Capture Element outlines whatever is under your pointer and crops to it exactly.
- [Auto-Redact Sensitive Info](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-auto-redact-sensitive-info): GoFully's Auto-redact reads your screenshot on your device and covers emails, card numbers, phone numbers, ID numbers, IP addresses and API keys with black boxes you review before export.
- [Step-by-Step Guide Builder](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-make-a-step-by-step-guide-from-screenshots): Turn several GoFully captures into one how-to document. Add captions, reorder steps and export a PDF or a Markdown ZIP, all on your device.
- [Local Multi-Language OCR](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-extract-text-in-multiple-languages-ocr): Extract text from images and locked web apps on-device in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese without cloud uploads. Includes instant 'Copy as JSON'.
- [Screenshot Annotation & Highlighter](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-use-highlighter-tool-in-screenshots): CleanShot-style multiply-blend highlighter, curved arrows, callouts, step counters, and 6 shapes (rectangle, circle, ellipse, triangle, polygon).
- [Privacy Redaction & Blur](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-blur-sensitive-info-in-screenshots): Gaussian smooth blur, mosaic pixelate, and black redaction for PII, tokens, and passwords.
- [Screenshot Beautifier & Mockups](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-beautify-screenshots): Add customizable gradient backgrounds, realistic window frames with live page URLs and lock icons, padding, shadows, and multi-image collages.
- [Flexible High-Resolution Export](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-save-webpage-as-pdf): Export to paginated A4 PDF, PNG, WebP, JPG with unified quality control, and 4K UHD.
- [Local Screenshot History](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/): Rolling history of your last 50 captures stored only in browser local storage, searchable by the text inside each screenshot, with optional full-image reopening for the last 10.

## New in v1.1.3 (publishing next)

- Redact page: covers emails, card numbers, phone numbers, ID numbers, IBANs, IP addresses and API keys on the live page, in text and form fields, plus anything the user clicks. It keeps covering text that loads later, so full-page captures stay covered. Done restores the page. Runs on the device.
- Measure: hover any element to see what it is, its size, padding, margin and text style; click one and hover another for the gap; drag a free ruler; pick any color on screen as hex.
- Delayed capture: 3, 5 or 10 seconds, with a countdown on the page that is left out of the image, so menus and tooltips can be captured. Esc cancels.
- Capture stack: quick captures stay in the corner of the page with their own Copy, Save, Edit and Pin buttons, and can be dragged into other apps. Settings chooses what happens after a capture.
- QR codes and barcodes: read on the device from any capture and listed on its card, and in the editor with Find codes. Only http and https links get an Open button.

## Comparison & Alternatives

- [GoFully Alternatives Hub](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/alternatives): Feature-by-feature comparison against GoFullPage, Awesome Screenshot, FireShot, and Nimbus.
- [GoFully vs GoFullPage](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/alternatives/gofullpage): 100% free capture with local OCR, free annotations, and redaction vs paywalled editing.
- [GoFully vs Awesome Screenshot](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/alternatives/awesome-screenshot): Zero cloud uploads and no account required vs cloud tracking and paywalls.
- [GoFully vs FireShot](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/alternatives/fireshot): Modern CleanShot design and free multi-page PDF export vs legacy UI and paid pro license.
- [GoFully vs Nimbus Capture](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/alternatives/nimbus): Lightweight, offline performance vs bloated cloud-sync software.

## Guides & Documentation

- [Full Page Screenshot in Chrome](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-take-full-page-screenshot-chrome): Step-by-step guide to capturing entire web pages.
- [Developer & QA Bug Reporting](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/screenshot-tool-for-developers-and-qa): Capturing bug states, preserving console overlays, and exporting ticket attachments.
- [Custom Keyboard Shortcuts](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/custom-keyboard-shortcuts-for-screen-capture): Remapping native hotkeys in Chrome.
- [Extract Unselectable Text](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-extract-unselectable-text): Using local OCR on paywalled content, canvas elements, and images.
- [Save Webpage as Paginated PDF](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/how-to-save-webpage-as-pdf): Converting long documents and legal terms into clean multi-page PDFs.
- [Privacy-First Screenshot Tools](https://gofully-extension.vercel.app/guides/privacy-first-screenshot-tools): Why offline capture matters and how client-side WASM guarantees privacy.
